svg.text: Transfer - delta C picks each cookie off the band end into a passing puck on the right bend
OK - row emptied in the pick window: 30.5 s >= 6 takts = 24 s delta C takes one cookie per takt; a row never reaches the nose
OK - transfer capacity, delta C: 0.50 /s >= demand 0.25 /s single transfer: a miss falls into the crumb pan (counted loss) - the band cannot stop with the oven hot
OK - place window on the bend: 98 mm = 4.9 s >= reach+grip 0.8 s delta C tracks the puck along the arc (IK at 7 points)
OK - cookie at the picker: max 37.5 C after 68 s on the loop <= T_PACK 38 C a warm cookie sealed in film sweats (condensate in the pack)
I/O: I1, I9, NFC-W, delta_C.M180, delta_C.M300, delta_C.M60, delta_C.VAC
Parts: delta_C x22, portal x4, sensor x3
